annotations.title: Get a payment link for a prepaid pack

description: Creates a Stripe Checkout payment link for a prepaid pack on the connected account and returns the URL. Nothing is charged by this tool: a person opens the link and pays by card, and the credits land on the account once paid. Needs a live, self-serve account that names its client business. Prices are in minor units in the response.
